behaviour: Preserves finite positive `arrowheadSize` values on restored `line` and `arrow` elements and strips invalid or `undefined` values.
rules: 1. In `restoreElementWithProperties`, after `delete ret.moveMidPointsWithElement;`, if `"arrowheadSize" in ret && (!isLinearElement(ret) || !isFiniteNumber(ret.arrowheadSize) || ret.arrowheadSize <= 0)`, delete `(ret as any).arrowheadSize`.

2. In `restoreElement` for `case "line": case "draw":` and `case "arrow":`, include `...(isFiniteNumber(element.arrowheadSize) && element.arrowheadSize > 0 ? { arrowheadSize: element.arrowheadSize } : {})` in the properties passed to `restoreElementWithProperties`.

sites.rule: Keep `delete ret.moveMidPointsWithElement;` and delete `(ret as any).arrowheadSize` whenever `"arrowheadSize" in ret` and `!isLinearElement(ret) || !isFiniteNumber(ret.arrowheadSize) || ret.arrowheadSize <= 0`.
Preserve `arrowheadSize: element.arrowheadSize` on restored `line` elements when `isFiniteNumber(element.arrowheadSize) && element.arrowheadSize > 0`.
Preserve `arrowheadSize: element.arrowheadSize` on restored `arrow` elements when `isFiniteNumber(element.arrowheadSize) && element.arrowheadSize > 0`.

rules: 1. Export `CHANGE_ARROWHEAD_SIZE_TYPES = new Set<ElementOrToolType>(["arrow", "line"])` and `export const canChangeArrowheadSize = (type: ElementOrToolType) => CHANGE_ARROWHEAD_SIZE_TYPES.has(type)`.

2. In `getShapeActionPredicates`, add `arrowheadSize: targetElements.some((element) => isLinearElement(element) && canChangeArrowheadSize(element.type) && (Boolean(element.startArrowhead) || Boolean(element.endArrowhead)))`.

sites.rule: Add `arrowheadSize` boolean flag to `getShapeActionPredicates` return object.

behaviour: Implements `actionChangeArrowheadSize` with Small (`0.5`), Medium (`1`), and Large (`1.5`) radio presets and wires it into `actionChangeArrowProperties`.
rules: 2. Export `actionChangeArrowheadSize = register<number>({ name: "changeArrowheadSize", label: "labels.arrowheadSize", trackEvent: false, perform, PanelComponent })`.

3. In `perform(elements, appState, value, app)`, assert `invariant(value, "actionChangeArrowheadSize: value must be defined")`, and use `changeProperty(elements, appState, (el) => ...)` to update every selected element where `isLinearElement(el) && canChangeArrowheadSize(el.type) && (el.startArrowhead || el.endArrowhead)` via `newElementWith(el, { arrowheadSize: value })` (and if `isElbowArrow(element)`, reroute with `newElementWith(element, updateElbowArrowRoute(element, app.scene.getNonDeletedElementsMap()))`), returning `{ elements, appState, captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }`.

4. In `PanelComponent`, render `
{t("labels.arrowheadSize")}
group="arrowhead-size" options={[{ value: 0.5, text: t("labels.small"), icon: FontSizeSmallIcon, testId: "arrowhead-size-small" }, { value: 1, text: t("labels.medium"), icon: FontSizeMediumIcon, testId: "arrowhead-size-medium" }, { value: 1.5, text: t("labels.large"), icon: FontSizeLargeIcon, testId: "arrowhead-size-large" }]} value={getFormValue(elements, app, (element) => (isLinearElement(element) ? element.arrowheadSize ?? 1 : null), (element) => isLinearElement(element) && canChangeArrowheadSize(element.type) && (Boolean(element.startArrowhead) || Boolean(element.endArrowhead)), (hasSelection) => (hasSelection ? null : 1))} onChange={(value) => updateData(value)} />
`.

sites.rule: Define and export `actionChangeArrowheadSize` and include `{renderAction("changeArrowheadSize")}` in `actionChangeArrowProperties`.

behaviour: Renders `changeArrowheadSize` in `SelectedShapeActions` and `CombinedArrowProperties` when `predicates.arrowheadSize` is true.
rules: 2. In `CombinedArrowProperties`, change the early return condition from `if (!predicates.arrowType)` to `if (!predicates.arrowType && !predicates.arrowheadSize)`.

behaviour: Copies and clears `arrowheadSize` in `actionPasteStyles` inside the `newElement.type === "arrow" && isArrowElement(elementStylesToCopyFrom)` block before elbow arrow rerouting.
rules: 1. In `actionPasteStyles`, inside the existing `if (newElement.type === "arrow" && isArrowElement(elementStylesToCopyFrom))` block, copy `startArrowhead: elementStylesToCopyFrom.startArrowhead` and `endArrowhead: elementStylesToCopyFrom.endArrowhead`, and when `newElement.arrowheadSize !== elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize`, update `newElement = newElementWith(newElement, { arrowheadSize: elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize }, true)` and `if (elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize === undefined) { delete newElement.arrowheadSize; }`, before the `if (isElbowArrow(newElement))` reroute.

sites.rule: Inside the `newElement.type === "arrow" && isArrowElement(elementStylesToCopyFrom)` block, copy `arrowheadSize` (deleting `newElement.arrowheadSize` when `elementStylesToCopyFrom.arrowheadSize === undefined`) alongside `startArrowhead` and `endArrowhead`, before `if (isElbowArrow(newElement))`.
